title: Bounded constructible representative for closed support
statement: Fix a universe u, a prime ell and a field k of positive characteristic different from ell. All schemes are separated finite-type k-schemes in u. Let Lambda be a commutative condensed ring with a certificate IsEllAdicCoefficient ell Lambda, allowing continuous finite extensions, integral valuation rings with torsion, and the finite-subextension-valued algebraic closure [def-sfb-adic-coefficient-certificate]. Write B_T for the full bounded constructible subcategory of the ordinary unbounded derived category of internal Lambda_T-module objects [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible; sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. For every closed immersion i:Z -> X and K in B_X, closed pushforward is exact and there are L in B_Z and epsilon:D(i_*)L -> K such that a |-> D(i_*)(a);epsilon is a bijection Hom(M,L) -> Hom(D(i_*)M,K) for every M in B_Z. Exactness is returned as a witness so that the expression D(i_*) needs no unproved global instance.

source.place: Part (2), closed-support localization; sk-prop-closed-adjoint-constructible-support.proof.md and sk-thm-int-restriction-closed.proof.md; Lean split: lean/Sheaf/AlgebraicGeometry/EllAdicClosedSupportRepresentable.lean (closed_support_representable)

proof.text: The open complement j is quasi-compact by Noetherianity. Obtain exact i_*, bounded-below Ri!, both adjunctions, the invertible i*i_* counit, and the distinguished localization triangle i_*Ri!K -> K -> Rj_*j*K from condensed_open_closed_recollement.

Prove the constructible Serre conditions for each certificate: local finite freeness for continuous finite fields (with universe lifting), the integral constructible Serre theorem with induced norm, and the finite-subextension algebraic-closure Serre theorem. Apply bounded_tri_of_serre to obtain a triangulated bounded constructible property.

Exact j* preserves bounded constructibility; Rj_* preserves it by the existing finiteness theorem. The triangle makes i_*Ri!K bounded constructible. Exact i* and its invertible counit make Ri!K bounded constructible.
Take the bounded-below adjunction counit included in the ordinary derived category. Full faithfulness of this inclusion identifies postcomposition with the adjunction Hom equivalence.

theorem closed_support_representable
    {Z X : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Z.hom] [QuasiCompact Z.hom] [IsSeparated Z.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom] [IsSeparated X.hom]
    (hΛ : IsEllAdicCoefficient ℓ Λ inferInstance)
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i.left]
    (K : (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)).FullSubcategory) :
    Exists fun [_hclosed : PreservesFiniteColimits ((i.left)_*⟦Λ⟧)] ↦
      ∃ L : (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ Z.left)).FullSubcategory,
        ∃ ε : D((i.left)_*⟦Λ⟧).obj L.obj ⟶ K.obj,
          ∀ M : (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ Z.left)).FullSubcategory,
            Function.Bijective (fun a : M.obj ⟶ L.obj ↦
              D((i.left)_*⟦Λ⟧).map a ≫ ε)
